hero.h1: Lighting Control Installation in South Lake Tahoe
hero.sub: Every light and shade in the house from one keypad, a remote, or your phone. Scenes for the morning, dinner, and bedtime, set once and there every day.

items.p: If only all businesses were so helpful! I called these guys early one morning after a tenant phone call stating their power was off. Chip the owner returned my call at 7:30 AM on a Friday.

Hatch was great! We had to replace our incoming electrical panel per our insurance company, and Hatch got us a prompt quote and fit us into their schedule so we could finish the work before our insurance company was going to drop us.
Best electricians in town with the fairest prices. Won't try to gauge you on initial assessment fees just charge a basic hourly fee and do the work that's necessary.
One button sets the whole room: cooking, dinner, a movie, bedtime. Each keypad is programmed to how you live in that room.
Cooler light by day, warm light at night, tuned to your body clock. The house feels calm and you sleep better.
Every button engraved with what it does, so no guest hunts for a switch. Keypad finishes picked to match your hardware and trim.

about.p: Leonard Hatch founded Hatch Electric in 1951 and moved it to South Lake Tahoe in 1962. Chip Henderson started here as an apprentice electrician in 1976 and has run the company since 2002, and we still serve clients Leonard Hatch first signed.

steps.p: We walk the plans with you and the owner and settle how each room is lit and controlled.
Fixtures, keypads, shades, and loads on paper before the walls close, so nothing is pulled twice.
Our own technicians install, program every scene, and test the system with the owner.
Scenes adjusted once the home is lived in, and our own technicians to call when anything needs a look.

items.q: Can lighting control go into a finished home?
items.a: Yes. Wireless keypads and dimmers replace the switches you have, with no new wiring in most rooms.

items.q: What do I control it from?
items.a: A keypad on the wall, a handheld remote, a tabletop control, or your phone or tablet.
One button that sets several lights at once, like dinner, movie, or bedtime. We program each one with you.

items.q: Does it run the shades and the heat too?
items.a: Yes. Shades and temperature can run from the same keypads and schedules as the lights.

items.q: Will it cut my power bill?
items.a: Dimmed lights use less power than full brightness, and sensors turn lights off in empty rooms.

services.p: One team for the whole house.

items.p: Shades that cut glare, keep the view, and move with the lights.
Dimmers, keypads, and temperature control added to the home you have.
Lighting and control planned with you and your architect before the build.

final.p: Tell us about the rooms and pick a time to talk.
